_comment: SYNC_PROTOCOL.md §7.9 (M141 「会話を閉じる」, Review v0.1.43 #6 #7): rules every client applies the same way. close_event: whether a dm_close.updated is taken. An open (closed false) always is; a close is ignored (the DM stays open) when the client already holds a timeline message (its last_message, §7.8) with a seq above the event's closed_seq: that message reopened it on the server too. No closed_seq (an older server) or no last message: taken. restore_pin: a refused close puts back only its own pin: the channel goes back to its place before the close (clamped to the list as it is now), the other pins stay as events left them; a channel that was not pinned is only taken out. read_fallback: a refused close asks the server for the read state (PUT /channels/{id}/read {last_read_seq: 0}, a no-op answering the state) and takes it as it is; only when that fails too is the snapshot from before the close written back, and only if nothing changed the read state since the close set it (last_seq, last_read_seq, unread_count, mention_count as the close left them), otherwise it is kept for the next bootstrap. Hand-written; Desktop / Web, iOS and Android test against it.

close_event.name: an older server sends no closed_seq
closed after the newest message (edits, reactions, thread replies consumed seqs)
a newer message already here: it reopened the DM

restore_pin.name: not pinned before: only taken out
a pin removed meanwhile stays removed

read_fallback.name: an edit or a reaction moved last_seq: kept
